title: Foo Bar Taxi Debug Broken Pipeline
description: Fix 4 bugs in a pre-scaffolded TypeScript taxi data pipeline: a type error in the schema definition, a wrong table name in the API handler, a column mismatch in the materialized view definition, and a missing import in the ingestion script.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must diagnose and fix 4 bugs in a broken TypeScript taxi data pipeline that is supposed to ingest raw data, create materialized views, and serve an API -- but nothing works due to a type error, wrong table reference, column mismatch, and missing import.

tasks.description: Fix the type error in src/schema.ts where a ClickHouse column name uses the wrong TypeScript type (number instead of string).
Fix the wrong table name in src/api.ts that references analytics.taxi_data instead of analytics.taxi_trips.
Fix the column mismatch in src/mv.ts where the MV definition selects 'fare' but the target table expects 'fare_amount'.
Fix the missing import for the ClickHouse client in src/ingest.ts.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse pre-seeded with raw.yellow_trips_2024_01 and raw.green_trips_2024_01 staging tables. A broken TypeScript project is scaffolded in /workspace/.
